title: fix(spec,objectql): installed pages carrying a retired declaration convert at load instead of stopping the kernel build
body:
Fixes #23904
Clause-②: yes (widening)

An already-installed package or stored page carrying a declaration spec 18 retires no longer stops the environment's kernel build. The mechanism is the ADR-0087 D2 transition pattern, not a tolerance switch in the registry: two retired conversion entries that data at rest replays, plus the versioned artifact window opened at the one door every package registration reaches. The authoring, save and publish doors refuse exactly what they refused before.

## What changes

| Door | Before | Now |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `definePage` / `defineStack` (`os validate`, `os build`), the metadata save door (`PUT /api/v1/meta`), package publish | refused at `pages.N.isDefault` / `pages.N.template` | unchanged, same sentence (pins: `page-default-and-region-placement.test.ts`, `default-record-page-save-door.test.ts`) |
| a `sys_metadata` page row read back | served with `_diagnostics.valid: false` | converted on read: `isDefault` deleted off a non-bound page, `full-width` re-spelled `default`, one `OS_METADATA_CONVERTED` notice per site (pin: `page-default-and-region-placement.test.ts` ledger block) |
| a compiled artifact inside the window its `engines.protocol` opens | refused at the artifact door's strict parse | converted before the parse, as every retired entry is (pins: the whole-step blocks in `artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` and `artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts`, which now carry both entries) |
| a package body registered through `manifest.register` / `ObjectQL.registerApp` that declares `engines.protocol` (an installed package, a marketplace install, a hosted kernel's loader) | `MisplacedDefaultPageError`, kernel build stopped | converted before anything registers; one `warn` per (package, conversion) naming the conversion id, the floor and the first site (pin: `registry-installed-package-retired-page-declarations.test.ts`) |
| the same body with no declared range (a manifest a plugin builds in code), or declaring a floor newer than every retirement | refused | unchanged, refused (CONTROL pins in the same file and in `registry-default-record-page.test.ts`, untouched) |

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`: `page-is-default-off-record-page-removed` (strips `isDefault: true` from exactly the pages `misplacedDefaultPageRefusal` refuses, the parse's one judge) and `page-template-full-width-to-default`; both `toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, order 67, inserted at their id-sorted positions with their definitions directly above the entry that follows (the step-18 merge-shape test is green).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: `ObjectQL.convertPackageBodyForward(body)` replays `applyArtifactForwardConversions` over a body that declares a protocol range; `registerApp` registers the converted copy (record, live manifest, every item). `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`: the `manifest` service converts an artifact that carries `packages[]` once, before `resolveArtifactPackageOrder` strict-parses its bodies. Idempotent and copy-on-write: a body an artifact door already converted comes back by reference with no notice.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts`: a definition with no `manifest` key reads its declared range off itself (the flat package-body shape); one with a `manifest` object is read there, as before.
- D3 entries `page-is-default-off-record-page-refused` / `page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused`: prose now names the data-at-rest halves; no new tombstone, no new key. `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`: the `isDefault` and `template` notes carry the load-path reading (state counts unchanged).
- Fixture: `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-4.0.1-published-pages.artifact.json`.

## Readings (PM mechanism assumptions, measured)

1. **Call chain of the measured failure.** The cloud log names `MisplacedDefaultPageError`, the registry's own throw. The strict body parse (`resolveArtifactPackageOrder` → `ArtifactPackageSchema`, run by the `manifest` service on an artifact carrying `packages[]`, by `createStandaloneStack`, by `loadArtifactBundle`'s readers) would have refused HotCRM 4.0.1 FIRST, with a Zod issue at `packages.1.manifest.pages.5.isDefault` (and at `template` / `regions`), never with that error name. So the kernel that failed registered the package bodies flat, through `manifest.register` / `registerApp` → `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` → `refuseDefaultRecordPageConflicts` (`registry.ts` package door), with no parse and no artifact file door in between. Both throws (`:2717` package door, `:4652` item seam) sit behind `registerApp`; the door now converts ahead of both. `template` and `regions`: the registry never judged them (parse-only refusals, as #23708 recorded), so on that chain they never fired; they fire at the strict-parse doors only.
2. **Mechanism premise, partly false.** On the artifact file doors (`loadArtifactBundle`, `MetadataPlugin`, `AppPlugin`) the registry already sees converted bytes, so the D2 entry alone fixes them. On the flat registration chain above nothing converted before the registry, so the entry alone would not have fixed the measured path; the versioned window is therefore opened at `registerApp`, gated on a declared range so a code-registered manifest keeps today's refusals. HotCRM 4.0.1 declares `engines.protocol: ^17.7.0` (floor 17.7.0 < 18.0.0): verdict `converted-forward`, 152 + 3 + 1 sites across the chain.
3. **Which side a new install of a published version falls on.** A published artifact always declares its range (`os build` stamps it), so the marketplace install of 4.0.1 takes the load posture; publishing a new version goes through `os build`, whose parse refuses the shapes. `POST /api/v1/packages` (`protocol.installPackage`) and the `sys_packages` boot hydration call `registry.installPackage` directly and are NOT covered by this door (see acceptance notes).
4. **Named warning.** The structured `OS_METADATA_CONVERTED` notice of each entry, surfaced at the registration door as one `[ObjectQL] package '…' … ADR-0087 conversion 'CONVERSION-ID' converted N site(s) forward (first at …)` warn per (package, conversion), deduped per process, the wording family `MetadataPlugin`'s artifact door prints; the stored-row seams and artifact doors surface it through their existing channels.
5. **Artifact source.** `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at tag `v4.0.1` (`1d7148bf2d3a`), cloned read-only and built with its own pinned toolchain (`@objectstack/cli` 17.7.0 → `dist/objectstack.json`, 2.4 MB, option-B, two package bodies). The repository commits no `dist/` and the GitHub release API answered 403 to this session, so the artifact was built, not downloaded. The fixture is that artifact trimmed to its `manifest` and each body's manifest fields plus the FULL `pages` collection (8 pages, byte-identical). Not a hand-made shape.
6. **Ablations.** (a) D2 entry: the `{ conversion: pageIsDefaultOffRecordPageRemoved, order: 67 }` line deleted from step 18 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete --hold`, anchor 1 → 0 on disk), spec rebuilt: the boot test 4 of 8 red (the same four cases as (b)), the 4 refusal controls green; restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, blob `2e91e262` equals `HEAD`, anchor 1 again, spec rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/spec 'page-is-default-off-record-page-removed'` → present in 8 built files, 8 of 8 green. The mutated leg's `--absent` preflight exited 4: the id string is also prose in the D3 entry this PR edits, so `dist/migrations/index.{js,mjs}` still carried it (2 hits, both migrations) while the 6 conversion-dist files had lost it — the dist reading of the mutation is the 8 → 2 drop, read off the two preflight outputs. (b) Registration door (`engine.ts`, the declared-range guard replaced by an unconditional return, source resolved from `src`): 4 of 8 cases red (`× registers both package bodies …`, `× … registers through manifest.register …`, `× … without a second warning …`, `× an artifact declaring ^17.7.0 …`), the 4 refusal controls green; restored, blob `d45112dd` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## The other load-time refusals of the same commit (reviewed, measured)

- **`template: 'full-width'`** → D2 `page-template-full-width-to-default`. objectui at the pin `daeb77fc84dd` maps `'default'` and `'full-width'` to the one `FullWidthTemplate` component (`renderers/layout/page.tsx`, `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY`), so the re-spelling draws the page exactly as before. HotCRM 4.0.1 ships three such pages.
- **An unregistered template name** (`centered`, `utility-bar` in 4.0.1): the renderer fell back to the page-type layout (`resolveTemplate` → `null` → `HomePageLayout` / `AppPageLayout` / `UtilityPageLayout` = `RegionLayout(regions, pageType)`), which is the same layout `FullWidthTemplate` draws, differing only in the `data-page-layout` attribute's source. Deliberately NOT converted: "any string outside the set" is not a shape a conversion positively recognizes (the module's own rule), so a D2 entry would rewrite shapes it cannot name. It stays with the parse; the registry never judged it, so the measured chain is unaffected.
- **A region the template does not place** (`left_sidebar` / `right_sidebar` on 4.0.1's `three-column` home page): the renderer did render them, stacked under `main` (`getRemainingRegions` → `extras`), so dropping them loses content and renaming them (`sidebar` / `aside`) moves them beside `main`: no lossless rewrite exists, and which slot was meant is the author's call (D3 `page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused`). Not converted; same reach as above.

## Acceptance

- a kernel built from HotCRM 4.0.1's published bundle boots, with the named warning: `registry-installed-package-retired-page-declarations.test.ts` › "a kernel built from HotCRM 4.0.1's published bundle boots, with the named warning" (both bodies at the engine door with the artifact's package list; the measured package alone through `manifest.register`; dedupe on re-registration);
- the same page saved or published through the authoring door is still refused: `page-default-and-region-placement.test.ts` (parse, `defineStack`), `default-record-page-save-door.test.ts` (save door, untouched), and the CONTROL block of the new file (range-less body, newer-than-every-retirement body, the item seam);
- an ablation of the load-time path turns the boot red: §Readings 6.

Through the strict-parse artifact doors (`os start --artifact`, `createStandaloneStack`), HotCRM 4.0.1 is refused regardless of this PR, on three `controlled_by_parent` objects with no required `master_detail` (ADR-0055 §1, a D3 semantic refusal older than #23708) and on the two shapes above with no lossless rewrite. Measured by parsing the built artifact after the full chain: 11 issues, 8 on pages, 3 on `sharingModel`. That door was not the measured failure and is not widened here.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not changed here)

- `services/service-package` boot hydration (`registry.installPackage(rec.manifest)` from `sys_packages`) and `metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.installPackage` (`POST /api/v1/packages`) call the registry's package door directly, bypassing `registerApp`: a stored package record carrying a misplaced default still meets `MisplacedDefaultPageError` there (the hydration catches it, so the boot continues without that package). Seam: `spec:ADR-0087 addendum 2026-07-31 (every rehydration seam replays the chain)` → `runtime:packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts hydration loop`, consumer: the registry. Reported for the seat, not fixed in this PR.
- `cloud-connection`'s marketplace install hands the fetched bundle to `manifest.register` raw (now converted at that door) but its side readers (`bindArtifactHandlers`, `applySideEffects`) read the unconverted ledger entry; pre-existing, not a page concern.
- The registry's two throws stay in place as the authority for a body that survives conversion (no declared range, or a floor past every retirement).

## Verification

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cloud-connection...' build` (closure, exit 0), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build` (exit 0), under `os-verify-lock`.
- Tests (all under the lock, exit codes captured before any pipe): spec `src/conversions src/migrations src/ui/page-default-and-region-placement.test.ts src/ui/page.test.ts src/ui/default-record-page.test.ts src/stack-default-record-page.test.ts src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` + `scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` → green after the repin (1157 tests); metadata-core `pnpm test` → exit 0; objectql `registry-installed-package-retired-page-declarations`, `registry-default-record-page`, `artifact-load-path`, `registry-artifact-co-ownership`, `registry-security-catalog-namespace`, `protocol-install-package`, `manifest-service-residual-objects` → exit 0; metadata `plugin-artifact-forward-conversion` → exit 0; runtime `app-plugin-artifact-forward-conversion`, `standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion`, `load-artifact-bundle.granted-permissions` → exit 0; cloud-connection `marketplace-install-local-bundle`, `-hot-loaded` → exit 0.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/objectql` → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → green after `gen:liveness-counts` (0 shards rewritten). `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` → OK.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 94 families; each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 94 derived, 92 run (exit 0 except `check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --days 90`, exit 2: shallow clone, refuses the 90-day window), 2 NOT-MEASURED on a recorded exit 3 (prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (needs an unshallow clone) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`; only the cloud-connection closure was built here). Both are CI's on the PR. `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:liveness`, `check:api-surface` (rerun on the rebuilt dist: surface unchanged), `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface`: exit 0

Readings taken at `9fad187b` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit; the gate union and the ablations ran on that tree).
